notes: How often an unenforced schema fails, against the enforced one, on each model's game thinking level: json_schema (the provider enforces the schema; today's live mode) against json_mode (the schema as text after the prompt, the reply validated in code against the same schema, per-seat targets included). An enforced schema is part of the cache key on both providers, so json_mode is what would let different call types and seats share a prefix (evidence/caching/experiment_log.md §11 onward). 17 ten-seat schemas x 10 samples per mode, then 8 real Phase 3 discussion turns (3 variants each) in json_mode. The cache floor is a single size: not under test here.
